content_fields.title: Use a secure authentication mechanism for database connections (PostgreSQL)
content_fields.description: Use a strong authentication mechanism for PostgreSQL connections.
content_fields.guidance: The server should require scram-sha-256 or certificate authentication for every connection, with md5 and trust methods removed from the host-based configuration.
content_fields.found: The application supplies a username and password; the accepted authentication method is decided by the server's pg_hba.conf, which is not part of the repository.
content_fields.missing: pg_hba.conf and the server's password_encryption setting.
content_fields.conclusion: The authentication mechanism is chosen in the database server configuration.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should require scram-sha-256 and remove weaker methods.
